lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A primary cluster of high-luminance circular blobs is visible posterior to the fifth gill slit, forming a semi-regular grid. These spots are arranged in roughly horizontal rows, with three prominent blobs in the mid-lateral line forming a triangular configuration relative to the base of the first dorsal fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, creating a grid-like pattern where they intersect horizontal rows of high-luminance spots. This is most distinct in the mid-flank region between the pectoral fin and the first dorsal fin.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the lateral flank. The most prominent ridge runs through the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with light intensity at the apex and a defined shadow area immediately ventral to the ridge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains approximately 12-15 small, high-luminance spots. The distribution is non-uniform, with a higher concentration of pixels in the lower-anterior quadrant of the fin's surface area.

other_distinctive_markers: A dense constellation of micro-spots is visible on the cranial region anterior to the gill slits, transitioning to larger, more widely spaced blobs along the posterior lateral line.
